opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK resident, holding a current long‑term appointment at a UK higher education institution or independent research organisation, and conducting research in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK‑based researchers to develop new quantitative, data‑science, digital humanities or language skills and to disseminate them through innovative activities.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or recognised research organisation; UK/EU nationals (or any nationality with a UK doctorate) who have completed their viva between 1 Apr 2024‑1 Apr 2027 and are not in a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowship to carry out independent research leading to a publishable output, funded at 80 % of salary costs under Full Economic Costing.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a permanent or fixed‑term UK position, teaching/admin duties, proposing interdisciplinary work across the Academy remits (humanities, social sciences, science, engineering).
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for curiosity‑driven, interdisciplinary research that bridges humanities, social sciences, natural sciences and engineering, for up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences with an established UK university or research institute appointment; must involve overseas co‑applicants and genuine interdisciplinary collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year projects led by UK humanities/social sciences researchers with international partners, focusing on mobilities across disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ and mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowship (hosted at DGAP in Berlin) to develop policy‑relevant research in security, Indo‑European relations, technology or AI, with a budget for staff and public‑engagement costs.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers at any career stage in the humanities or social sciences; prior public‑engagement experience preferred.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects with GLAM or performing‑arts partners, up to £8,000.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Provides extra support (equipment, caring costs, or other needs) to enable research or application preparation; normally up to £4,000 but higher amounts possible in exceptional cases.
